before_board.S: A subset A of F_3^n of density delta with no three-term arithmetic progression.
before_board.M: Large Fourier coefficient, then restrict to a hyperplane.
before_board.C: About 1/delta iterations, each costing one dimension.

leak: The per-step gain delta^2 against the additive cost of one dimension per step forces delta >~ 1/n. The invariant composes additively while the target (maximum cap size) is supermultiplicative under products, so the truth has the form c^n.
